I rewrote `requirements.md` for the branch-audit-merge task. The original had a 30-word title and paragraphs of 90 to 130 words. `Server/text-check.mjs` found no flags either before or after the rewrite, so those two were my own failures of the Short check.

The new version has a short title, a one-line why, and a ticked checklist of the five asks. The fence is kept as its own section. No ask was changed or dropped.

I logged one "rewrote" line in `flags.jsonl`, and it validated with 0 bad lines.
